instructions_for_builder: Authoritative base app is Don_Downs_Mountain_Guide_V7_1_5.zip. This file is app-ready but does not itself modify the app. Apply 'updates' to EXISTING seeded gear IDs with a one-time stored-locker refresh, because saved gear has precedence over seed data. Use a new refresh flag such as ddmg-v7-2-gearnames. Update name, weightOz, weightSource, category/location/status if explicitly supplied, and note; do not reset the user's checked/packed state. Add 'new_items' through the normal BASE_GEAR merge. Do not duplicate IDs. Weights are ounces. Footwear, gaiters, and traction are per pair. WeightSource distinguishes manufacturer/retailer specs from estimates.

updates.name: Marmot PreCip rain jacket (red, M)
updates.note: Verified from gear photos. Hood, pit zips; lives in the Flash 18 on summit days.

updates.name: Down hoody, navy/red liner (likely REI Co-op 650 — confirm)
updates.note: Camp puffy for the 35-40°F Lake Como night. Brand unconfirmed from photos. Alternative: Patagonia Down Sweater Vest (7.8 oz) if cutting weight.

updates.name: SOL Emergency Bivvy (orange)
updates.note: Label-verified from photos. Rides in the Flash 18 every summit day.

updates.name: AMK Ultralight/Watertight .5 first-aid kit
updates.note: Check contents and expirations before departure; add blister supplies per existing plan.

updates.name: Sawyer Squeeze system + pouches + cleaning coupling
updates.note: Filter alone 3 oz (mfr). Backflush before the trip; primary water source at Lake Como camp.

updates.name: Anker PowerCore III Sense 10K (10,000 mAh)
updates.note: Model verified from label photo. Roughly two full phone charges; top off at the motel Sunday night.

updates.name: Black Diamond Sprinter 500 (blue)
updates.note: Primary. 500 lm, dual-fuel: BD 1800 rechargeable OR 3xAAA, rear red flasher. Charge before Saturday; carry spare AAAs as dual-fuel backup.

updates.name: Black Diamond Spot 400 (octane)
updates.note: Backup on AAAs. Official Spot 400 weight is 86 g / 3.0 oz with AAA batteries, or 72 g with BD1500; use fresh AAAs at the Friday readiness check.

updates.name: Kahtoola MICROspikes, size L + tote
updates.note: Conditional — decide from the final conditions reports; August need is unlikely.

updates.name: Under Armour Storm liner gloves
updates.note: Verified from photos. Pairs with the summit-morning start.

updates.name: MISSION Cooling Bucket Hat with neck cape (stone)
updates.note: Cooling fabric activates with water — useful on the exposed road walk and approach.

updates.name: Snow Peak Ti Single 450 mug + Rahuen Ti long spork
updates.note: Mug 2.4 oz (mfr) + spork ~0.8 oz. Sunday 3:30 AM coffee vessel; long spork reaches RTE pouch bottoms.

updates.name: Primary footwear — choose from owned set (see notes)
updates.note: Owned, all size 10, per pair: Oboz Sawtooth Mid B-DRY ~38 oz (estimate; ankle support for the loaded carry); Merrell Moab 3 32.5 oz (mfr, 460 g/shoe); TNF Ultra Fastpack IV FUTURELIGHT ~28 oz (retailer measurement, waterproof/light); La Sportiva Bushido II 21.0 oz (mfr, 10.5 oz/shoe; most precise — summit-day candidate); NB 610 ~23 oz (estimate; training tier).

base: Claude completed photo inventory plus spot audit against current manufacturer/retailer product specifications

audit_corrections.reason: Current Patagonia and REI listing for Men's Down Sweater Vest gives 252 g / 8.9 oz. Older model weights may vary; use 8.9 unless the garment tag or scale proves otherwise.
Black Diamond Spot 400 official listing gives 86 g with AAA batteries and 72 g with BD1500. For a AAA backup headlamp, app should carry 3.0 oz.

Footwear note refined to use official Merrell Moab 3 460 g per shoe, official La Sportiva Bushido II 10.5 oz per shoe, and a 14 oz per-shoe reference for TNF Ultra Fastpack IV Futurelight; other shoes remain estimates.
